title: Amelia Ross - People Ops manager prep Q2 2026
content:
Purpose:
- Quick notes for 1:1 with my manager (Ben), prep for calibration and Q2 goals. Keep bullets short.

High-level summary / FYI:
- Transitioned hiring focus to senior infra hires; 4 offers extended in Feb, 2 accepted, 1 declined (comp diff), 1 holding.
- Launched new onboarding checklist for Private team (pilot) — reduced first-week setup tasks by ~30% based on feedback forms.
- Began partnership with Eng PMs to standardize on OKR cadence for Dedicated product area.

Metrics I own / care about (current):
- Time-to-fill (senior infra): 56 days (target 45) — biggest blocker: interview loop availability.
- New hire ramp NPS (first 30d): 4.1/5 (baseline 3.6) — pilot onboard checklist helped.
- Attrition risk flags flagged this quarter: 3 (all individual contributor ICs) — action plans created.

Concrete examples of impact (stories):
- Offer negotiation: worked with candidate S to move from counter to acceptance by adjusting leveling band and clearer career path; helped close a critical vacancy on serving-runtime team.
- Onboarding pilot: created checklist + Slack onboarding channel + pairing schedule; Eng leads reported less context-switch time. Need to formalize for other product areas.
- Diversity sourcing: rerouted job postings to HBCU/Latinx networks; 2 positive pipeline responses so far.

Feedback I've heard (from managers/partners):
- + Loves the faster onboarding, asked for docs to be consumable by hiring managers.
- - Need to push harder on time-to-fill; hiring managers feel loop is long.
- Ask: more headcount forecasting input from People Ops earlier in roadmap planning.

Development goals (next 90 days):
- Reduce time-to-fill for senior infra roles to <= 45 days: experiment with two-week interview blitz and dedicated recruiter allocation.
- Build a lightweight hiring playbook for PMs/eng managers outlining expected steps and owner.
- Improve 30d new-hire survey response rate to 60% (currently ~40%) — add incentives and shorter form.
- Leveling calibration: work with Eng Leads and Research on clearer rubric for IC3-IC5 to reduce counteroffers.

Manager asks / discussion topics for 1:1:
- Headcount ask: Can we get approval to backfill 2 roles this quarter on infra? I have 2 high-priority reqs (serving-runtime + infra-systems).
- Budget tradeoff: recruiting contract vs internal recruiter FTE — recommend converting 0.5 contractor to full-time recruiter for Q3 to maintain pipeline.
- Escalation: guidance on how tightly to couple hiring timelines to product release schedules (can we push releases if roles open?).
- Calibration: request a 30-min sync with Eng Leadership to present leveling rubric draft.

Career / growth notes for manager: 
- Interested in owning a larger cross-functional operational charter (onboarding + hiring playbooks + talent planning) — want to level up to Sr People Partner scope.
- Looking for more stretch projects: leading the hiring plan for Dedicated product line in H2.

Open items / TODOs (short):
- Follow up with recruiting agency about candidate R by 2026-03-05.
- Draft hiring playbook outline and share with Lena by 2026-03-12.
- Prepare short slide (3-4 bullets) on why 0.5 recruiter -> FTE (cost/benefit) for next 1:1.
- Put calibration rubric on Confluence and ask Eng Leaders for 1-week async review.

Random notes / scratch:
- Candidate decline feedback: comp + slower offer timeline; consider faster loop + clear comp bands in job posts.
- Slack threads to reference: #hiring-infra, #onboarding-pilot, thread ts/abc123.
- Potential mentor: Priya (people-ops) for stakeholder mgmt; ask for 1 coaching session re: influencing without authority.

Draft closing line for manager update:
- "Quick update: onboarding pilot shows early wins (30% reduction in setup tasks), hiring velocity still primary blocker — seeking temporary recruiter capacity and permission to run a 2-week interview blitz to accelerate senior infra hires."

Unresolved questions (for manager):
- Do we have appetite to pause non-critical hires to prioritize infra?
- Will finance approve recruiter conversion this quarter?

End of notes.
